text: Customers may request a full refund within thirty days of purchase. After this period, refunds are issued as store credit only. Digital goods that have already been downloaded are excluded from refunds unless required by consumer law.

When an order is returned because of a defect, the company reimburses both the product price and the original shipping fees. For returns motivated by a change of mind, shipping costs are deducted from the reimbursed amount.
Approved reimbursements are processed within five business days. The amount is credited to the original payment method; card issuers may take an additional billing cycle to display the credit.
Standard domestic orders leave the warehouse within two business days and arrive within five. Express delivery guarantees arrival in forty-eight hours for orders placed before noon.
International parcels are dispatched twice a week and typically clear customs in three to ten days. Import duties and local taxes are the responsibility of the recipient.
Every parcel receives a tracking code sent by email at dispatch time. Tracking events update every six hours; a parcel with no movement for seven days triggers an automatic investigation.
Users can permanently close their account from the privacy section of the settings page. Closure takes effect immediately and outstanding balances are settled within one week.
Two-factor authentication can be enabled with an authenticator app or hardware key. After five failed sign-in attempts the account is locked for fifteen minutes.
Before deleting an account, users may export their complete history as a ZIP archive containing JSON files. The export link remains valid for seventy-two hours.
Personal data is retained for as long as the account remains active. After account deletion, backups containing personal data are purged within ninety days.
Customer information is never sold to third parties. Data is shared only with payment processors and delivery carriers, strictly to fulfil orders.
The website uses functional cookies for session management and optional analytics cookies that require consent. Consent choices can be revised at any time from the footer banner.
All hardware products include a two-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. Accidental damage, liquid ingress and unauthorized repairs void the coverage.
To open a warranty claim, submit the serial number and proof of purchase through the support portal. Replacement units ship after the defective item passes inspection.
An extended protection plan can be purchased within sixty days of the original order, adding up to three years of coverage including battery degradation below eighty percent.
Invoices are generated on the first day of each month and sent to the billing contact. Companies can register a tax identification number so invoices include it automatically.
Accepted payment methods include major credit cards, bank transfer and digital wallets. Bank transfers must clear before subscription features are activated.
Unpaid invoices accrue a late fee of two percent per month after a ten-day grace period. Service is suspended when an invoice is overdue by more than thirty days.
The support team is available from eight in the morning to eight in the evening on weekdays, and from nine to five on Saturdays. Critical incidents are handled around the clock.
Business-tier customers receive a first response within four hours for normal issues and thirty minutes for outages. Resolution targets depend on severity classification.
If a ticket remains unresolved after two exchanges, customers can request escalation to a senior engineer. Escalated cases are reviewed daily by the support manager.
The desktop application requires eight gigabytes of memory, four processor cores and two gigabytes of free disk space. Older operating systems released before 2019 are not supported.
Installation involves downloading the signed installer, verifying the checksum published on the security page, and running the setup wizard with administrator privileges.
If the installer fails with a permissions error, temporarily disable antivirus interference and re-run as administrator. Corporate machines may require an IT policy exception.
The public API allows one hundred requests per minute per key. Exceeding the quota returns status 429 with a Retry-After header; sustained abuse leads to key suspension.
API requests are authenticated with bearer tokens generated in the developer console. Tokens expire after ninety days and can be rotated without downtime by keeping two active keys.
Webhooks deliver order events with an HMAC signature header. Endpoints must respond within five seconds; failed deliveries are retried with exponential backoff for twenty-four hours.
Subscriptions can be cancelled at any moment and remain active until the end of the paid period. No partial refunds are given for unused days on monthly plans.
Orders can be cancelled free of charge while their status is pending. Once a parcel is handed to the carrier, cancellation is no longer possible and the return flow applies.
Annual contracts terminated early incur an exit fee equal to one month of service, except when termination follows a documented breach of the service agreement.
